description: Receipts for actual parent-loaded skills. Records studio-product-contract, studio-experience-routing, design/ui-ux-pro-max, creative:impeccable-design, design/app-life-and-style with accurate acceptance IDs/evidence.

receipts.trigger: Product contract gate for anonymous-first utility hub direction
receipts.outputArtifact: product/PRD.md v1.0, product/FLOWS.md v1.0, product/ARCHITECTURE.md v1.0, .studio/acceptance.json v1.0, .studio/slices.json v1.0
receipts.evidence: Anonymous-first free utility hub contract written with canonical route taxonomy, 9 stable capability categories, first proof vertical journey (batch cost), IA cleanup prerequisite, chemistry gating, and 5 anonymous flows. All requirements user-observable. Every core flow has e2e or deployed boundary. No fake evidence/status. StudioForge schema 1 compliance verified.

receipts.trigger: Experience routing gate for utility hub user journeys
receipts.evidence: Experience routing covers: homepage 2,000+ word visual module distribution, tool catalogue constrained desktop layout with mobile stack, first proof journey (tool catalogue → batch cost → visible result → local save/export/context handoff → reload/re-entry), IA cleanup vertical journey prior to route exposure. Every journey is dependency-ordered and thin. No legacy email/subscription slices.

receipts.outputArtifact: product/DESIGN.md v1.0 (design thesis, visual system, component grammar, homepage specification, tool catalogue specification, design acceptance criteria)
receipts.evidence: ui-ux-pro-max skill family loaded: design, brand, ui-styling, design-system sub-skills. Design tokens verified against app/globals.css. All tokens flagged as provisional pending Isaac approval. No new brand tokens invented. Homepage specification includes 8 visual modules with 2,000+ words. Tool catalogue specification includes desktop constrained layout and mobile stack with no horizontal overflow. Design gate for unresolved visual direction documented.

receipts.trigger: Impeccable design review for visual quality and consistency
receipts.outputArtifact: product/DESIGN.md v1.0 (design thesis, visual system, component grammar, motion vocabulary, accessibility requirements)
receipts.evidence: Impeccable design principles applied: calm production ledger aesthetic, no equal feature cards, no decorative KPI cards, factual feedback (not celebratory), status conveyed by icon/text not color only, 44px touch targets, reduced motion support, WCAG 2.2 AA target. All existing visual tokens from app/globals.css preserved as provisional. No generic stock photography. No brand mark without Isaac approval.

receipts.trigger: App life and lifestyle design routing
receipts.outputArtifact: product/DESIGN.md v1.0 (app life spec, signature interaction, core loop, primary metric, user constraints, accessibility budget)
receipts.evidence: App life spec covers: core loop (discover tool → enter inputs → see result → save/export/share → reload/re-entry), moment of truth (exact deterministic quantities, relevant warnings, save state visible), primary metric (anonymous completion rate and connected-tool continuation rate), user constraint (preserve context, never claim save that did not occur), personality (calm precision, practical craft, no magic language). Accessibility budget: WCAG 2.2 AA, keyboard complete, 44px targets, reduced motion, status beyond color.
